QixiaoAI PR Work System

Qixiao is a configurable AI PR work system for enterprises and brands. Dedicated models, company knowledge, and agent workflows connect discovery, assessment, response, and review so PR teams can move from information collection to coordinated decisions.

Book a product demoSee the decision loop
Discover→Understand→Assess→Act→Review

The limit of traditional monitoring is not collection—it is how quickly teams can understand, judge, and adapt.

When risk moves through context, communities, and propagation paths,
keywords and volume are not enough.

01

A keyword match is not real risk

Memes, irony, remixes, and reposts create noise. Brands need to understand the subject, tone, intent, and context—not merely whether a term appears.

02

Volume does not equal reputational harm

One highly shared clip may matter more than many low-engagement links. Priority should reflect account influence, velocity, and cross-platform spread.

03

Static reports cannot keep pace with risk

New memes, accounts, and issues emerge continuously. Fixed rules and project schedules struggle to match a PR team’s decision cycle.

THE PR DECISION LOOP

From seeing information
to action and review.

AI handles discovery, aggregation, assessment, and report drafting. Teams focus on fact-checking, strategy, and final statements. High-risk conclusions retain source evidence, rationale, and human review.

01 · DISCOVER

Open-web discovery

Bring together public media, social platforms, and long-tail communities, clean mixed-source content, and group scattered signals into trackable topics and events.

02 · UNDERSTAND

Semantic understanding

Use brand context to assess relevance, sentiment, intent, irony, and secondary spread, filtering false matches so attention stays on real risk.

03 · DECIDE

Event assessment

Combine source evidence, account influence, propagation paths, and history to provide risk level, rationale, and confidence, with responsible human review.

04 · ACT

Action guidance

Create response strategy, approved messaging, and an action checklist, then deliver them through existing collaboration channels such as Feishu and WeChat groups.

05 · LEARN

Review and retain

Team confirmations, exclusions, label changes, and response feedback return to dedicated knowledge, making the next similar judgment faster and closer to brand standards.

ONE SHARED CONTROL CENTER

Turn scattered posts into events,
and bring events into one control center.

Overview, topics, events, suspicious accounts, cross-platform trends, and reports share context, so PR teams do not rebuild judgment across disconnected tools.

CORE CAPABILITIES

Not another dashboard,
but a system that gets work done.

01

Topic monitoring

Keep ongoing observation and active incident detection in one view, prioritized by impact rather than raw volume.

02

Event intelligence

Group scattered posts into events and identify origin, key nodes, and the relationship between source content, remixes, clips, and reposts.

03

Coordinated-account radar

Use company-specific risk labels to assist in identifying suspicious and promotional accounts and track their active topics and platforms.

04

Cross-platform trends

Aggregate relevant trends and rankings so teams can see when an issue moves between platforms.

05

Analysis reports

Present trends, risk judgments, and actions in structured, conclusion-first reports configurable to company templates and brand visuals.

06

PR intelligence agent

Import content, adjust priorities, and launch tracking tasks through conversation; the agent continuously summarizes, prioritizes alerts, and produces daily reviews.

AGENT + KNOWLEDGE

Every human judgment
becomes the brand’s own PR asset.

Qixiao retains historical events, brand messaging, compliance boundaries, and team feedback in dedicated company knowledge. It continues to absorb judgment within clear human–AI boundaries.
